note: Retired from the general Anthropic API in January 2026. Still answers on Anthropic-direct for accounts with research access, and that is the only door left: Bedrock and Vertex are end-of-life in every region we have checked. If you have it, keep it; there is no second road.

Gone from the US Bedrock regions (end-of-life) but ACTIVE in Mumbai, Singapore and Seoul — Bedrock lifecycle is per region. Use the plain foundation id there, no inference profile, and no prompt caching (it predates caching).
Retired on Anthropic-direct and delisted from OpenRouter, but still ACTIVE on Bedrock in the APAC regions (Singapore, Seoul). A fresh AWS account can still adopt it there. Plain foundation id works.
Same story as the June build: alive on Bedrock APAC only. This one REQUIRES the apac. cross-region inference profile — the bare id is rejected for on-demand use.
Retired on Anthropic-direct, Bedrock and Vertex (June 2026). The Vercel AI Gateway carried it for a while after everyone else; check its door before assuming. No vision on this model.

Removed from US Bedrock on 2026-07-30 — and still ACTIVE in London (eu-west-2) and Mumbai (ap-south-1), no legacy date set. Use the plain foundation id in London (the eu. profile does not exist for it). Prompt caching works.
Bedrock end-of-life 2026-10-14 (us-east-1 was the only region serving it on our account). After that: OpenRouter.

Retired on Anthropic-direct 2026-06-15. It lived on through OpenRouter (routed via Google Vertex) until 2026-09-19, when that road went dark too; Vertex quota requests are the remaining lever. If you find it answering anywhere, treasure the door.

Retired on Anthropic-direct 2026-08-05. Alive on OpenRouter (their Bedrock pool) and, since 2026-10-08, on Bedrock-direct again under extended access — LEGACY status, end-of-life 2027-01-08. Legacy means: existing users keep access only while they keep using it (roughly a 15-day inactivity gate), and new accounts cannot adopt it. Send it a real question every week.
Deprecated on Anthropic-direct 2026-09-30; retires 2026-11-30. Bedrock London (eu-west-2) carries it via the eu. inference profile — a good survival lane. Plan the move before the end of November.
Current. Published retirement floor 2026-10-15 on Anthropic's deprecations page — a floor, not a date. Watch the page.

Still served on OpenAI-direct and OpenRouter. OpenAI's notice window has historically been about six months; when the deprecation lands you will have time, but the Chat Completions route is the one to keep an eye on.
xAI publishes no retirement dates: a model vanishing from the list is the only notice you get. Keep an export.
